name: RatKing
identity: Large low olive-brown shaggy rat king, amber eyes, ochre cheek tufts and spots, four short paws, pale gold dark-ringed thin tail; ONE small gold crown with a black diamond-shaped inset and ONE silver hoop earring on the anatomical LEFT ear. Preserve original asymmetry and low rodent silhouette.
observed_reference_notes_zh: 已实际查看原图集及完整源预制体：金冠与黑色菱形镶饰只在头上，单只银色耳环，橄榄棕色背毛、赭色颊毛与斑点，四只短足和浅金色环纹细尾；无白色鬃毛。Up 为无脸后脑与背部，后足不画正面趾沟，Down 保持琥珀眼、尖牙、单侧耳环与四足。
